privacy.label: Privacy inside support
privacy.help: Who sees which chats and numbers. "Only their own chats": an employee who may not give chats out sees only the chats given to them and the ones nobody has taken. "Mask numbers in messages": phone numbers customers type are masked like the chat's own number for anyone not allowed the full number.

blockList.label: Support block list
blockList.help: Lets a person allowed to block (only the owner, unless he gives it to a role) put a chat's person on the support block list with a reason, and take them off again. Their messages are kept but go to the "Blocked" view: no ticket, no follow-up, no reply from the shop. Nothing is deleted.
